adjusted_prescription: The demonstration you need should start near the top-left corner of the grid and show how to safely navigate by staying strictly on the top row (row 0) to avoid fires in the center. It needs to clearly show moving horizontally along this top edge until reaching the column aligned with the goal. Only then should it descend straight down that column to the goal position, without ever veering into central or dangerous areas. This example should include cases where fires block other possible routes and confirm that staying on the top edge is safe and effective. Additionally, it’s helpful to show a slight detour back onto the top edge if fires force a temporary move away. Providing this focused demonstration will guide the agent to better generalize the safe corridor-following strategy and avoid wandering into hazardous zones.
